style: High-quality Japanese mobile RPG character illustration, polished anime art style, clean crisp lineart, rich cel shading with soft gradients and rim light, vibrant saturated colors, detailed ornate costume, dynamic heroic pose, upper body to knees visible, character centered and facing slightly toward the viewer, face in the upper third of the image, single character only, no text, no logo, no watermark, no frame. Background: plain solid white, nothing else.

characters.prompt: Kagutsuchi, a hot-blooded young fire god from Japanese mythology. Spiky crimson hair with orange tips that turns into flickering flames at the ends, fierce golden eyes, confident fanged grin. Black and dark-red Japanese-inspired battle robe with gold trim and flame patterns, one shoulder armored, a blazing katana wreathed in fire held over his shoulder. Embers and sparks swirling around him.

Otohime, a gentle sea princess of the undersea Dragon Palace from Japanese folklore. Long flowing ocean-blue hair with lighter wave-like highlights, teal eyes, kind smile. Elegant white and aqua layered kimono-style dress with translucent sleeves like jellyfish fins, pearl and pink seashell hair ornaments, holding a small ornate jeweled box. Floating water droplets and bubbles around her.

Susanoo, a wild storm god from Japanese mythology. Messy untamed dark-green hair, bright lime-yellow eyes, bold grin, a long red headband fluttering in the wind. Rugged dark teal and black warrior outfit with green storm-cloud motifs and a torn cape, holding a great sword crackling with wind. Swirling gusts and leaves around him.

Amaterasu, the radiant sun goddess from Japanese mythology. Long golden hair glowing at the ends, warm orange eyes, serene confident smile. Pure white and gold shrine-maiden inspired divine robes with red accents, a large golden sun halo with rays behind her head, a sacred mirror floating beside her. Soft golden light and sparkles.

Tsukuyomi, a calm and mysterious moon god from Japanese mythology. Silver-lavender bob-cut hair, violet eyes, quiet expression. Deep navy and purple robe with silver crescent moon embroidery, a crescent moon hair ornament, holding a long staff topped with a glowing crescent. Faint stars and night mist around.

Brunhild, a brave valkyrie shield-maiden from Norse mythology. Golden blonde hair in a short cut with braids, bright blue eyes, determined smile. Silver plate armor with blue cloth and gold trim, a winged helmet, a large white feathered wing on her back, holding a spear and a round shield. Glowing feathers drifting around.

Loki, a mischievous trickster god from Norse mythology. Spiky jet-black hair with purple highlights, sly emerald-green eyes, smug grin. Dark green and black elegant coat with gold buckles, two curved golden horns on his head, playing cards and green magic flames floating in his hand. Shadowy illusion copies faintly behind him.

Siren, a playful mermaid songstress from European legend. Aqua-turquoise hair in twin tails, pink eyes, cheerful smile, translucent fin-shaped ears. Sea-themed idol-like outfit in turquoise and deep blue with scale patterns and pearl accessories, a shimmering mermaid tail, holding a coral microphone-like scepter. Swirling water and musical notes around her.
